description: Normalize adjacent MADE OF at the lexical stage by turning only the OF token into an already-ignored scaffolding word, so material questions reach the same classic interpretation as their shorter form without hardcoding a noun or sentence.

replacements.new:
<SET LEN ,P-LEXSTART>
	<SET CNT ,P-LEN>
	<REPEAT ()
	       <COND (<L? .CNT 2> <RETURN>)>
	       <SET LW <GET ,P-LEXV .LEN>>
	       <COND (<AND <EQUAL? .LW ,W?MADE>
			   <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV <+ .LEN ,P-LEXELEN>> ,W?OF>>
		      <PUT ,P-LEXV <+ .LEN ,P-LEXELEN> ,W?IS>)>
	       <SET LEN <+ .LEN ,P-LEXELEN>>
	       <SET CNT <- .CNT 1>>>
	<SET LW 0>
	<COND (<EQUAL? <SET WRD <GET ,P-LEXV .PTR>> ,W?OOPS>
